description: Typical dimensions, weight and desi of an everyday item when the user names the item but not its size (e.g. "my suitcase"). Known items: suitcase, box, shoes, document, phone, laptop, clothes, book, cosmetics. Returns sizes (e.g. cabin / medium / large suitcase) and the billed desi to use for prices. If the user gives real measurements, use those instead.

item.description: The item in the user’s words, e.g. "orta boy valiz", "ayakkabı kutusu"

size.description: Optional size if the user said it

name: estimate_parcel
title: Estimate parcel size
